title: Boon offer encoding
question: Draft frieze offers (Vital Bloom / Paean / Sun Balm) are ice text only. Loadout slots already tint by effect and show SVG icons. How should these offers communicate?

options.label: Match the slot language
options.thesis: Reuse effect/passive colors + the same SVG icons; add Active / Passive / Heal|Damage|Shield tags (and weapon gate when gated).
options.case: Scan parity with fight loadout; no new palette inventing.
options.risk: Warm damage tint sits near coral — keep flash coral exclusive; damage stays taxonomy only.

options.label: Cooler kylix remaps
options.thesis: Same icons + tags, but remake damage/heal/shield hues into cooler slip-blue family so nothing competes with coral flash.
options.case: Stronger world unity; breaks continuity with existing loadout kind colors unless those remaps too.
options.risk: Heal vs life-band and shield vs shield-band may blur if hues get too close.

options.label: Tags + icons, quiet color
options.thesis: SVG icons and Active/Passive/effect tags; color only as thin tint on the icon/tag, body text stays ice.
options.case: Safest against craft-floor color noise; weakest hierarchy at a glance.
options.risk: Still reads mostly monochrome on a quick glance.
